test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 02 March 2023)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘A # B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’.

If D @ N @ H & Y @ F % V, then how is N related to F?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 #
 
 
@

 
 
 
&

 
 
 
%

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 Brother
 Daughter
 
 
Husband

 
 
 
Wife

 
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

**Given statement :-** D @ N @ H & Y @ F % V

So,

 
• D @ N → D is the daughter of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ee01dde098306c87b89c8752c4bcba7d18ef1750658a99f80318c835fa29be5.png] 

 
• N @ H → N is the daughter of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/110ea6926385f8304d787d032dc440b6f25f0940bfe7f5b8e2516a6fef9bdd5a.png] 

 
• H & Y → H is the husband of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0b29f7584528fd8a3031df30a13609b553b5063f4774fab66a216b659136570.png] 

 
• Y @ F → Y is the daughter of F.

​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8e1509adc3c0dbb1bcb4d4fddfaef227549c09469d9f4834bf37750be8fd62f.png] 

 
• F % V → F is the wife of V.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec7abcf54b5ec92be976e30f3898ecf83894395e4ad16a3d3258e7253ca34aa7.png] 

**Thus, according to the final family tree N is the granddaughter i.e daughter's daughter of F.**

Hence,** "Daughter’s daughter**" is the correct answer.
